modelValue.zh-CN: 编辑器的文本，配合 v-model 使用；变为与编辑器当前内容不同的值时重建编辑器，与当前内容相同的回写不会丢失光标；未传时按空文本创建。
modelValue.en-US: Text of the editor, used with v-model. A value different from the editor's current content re-creates the editor; echoing the current content back keeps the caret. Without it the editor starts empty.

width.zh-CN: 宽度，数字按 px 处理，字符串原样使用。
width.en-US: Width. A number is taken as px; a string is used as is.

height.zh-CN: 高度，数字按 px 处理，字符串原样使用。
height.en-US: Height. A number is taken as px; a string is used as is.

showSearch.en-US: Whether to show the search button.

options.zh-CN: 编辑器配置，字段见 JsonViewerOptions。ariaLabel、readOnly、autoWrap 的默认值按键合并，只传部分字段时其余仍取默认值。内容按深比较变化时重建编辑器；就地修改 formatOptions、customRenderRule 等嵌套对象不会被察觉，需替换为新对象。
options.en-US: Editor options; see JsonViewerOptions for the fields. The defaults of ariaLabel, readOnly and autoWrap merge per key, so passing some fields keeps the defaults of the others. A deep change re-creates the editor; mutating a nested object such as formatOptions or customRenderRule in place goes unnoticed, so replace it with a new object.

limitSearchButtonBounds.zh-CN: 是否限制搜索按钮的拖动范围在组件容器内。
limitSearchButtonBounds.en-US: Whether to limit the search button drag bounds within the component container.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 编辑内容变化时触发，供 v-model 回写，参数为编辑器当前文本。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the content changes, for v-model to write back, with the editor's current text.

change.zh-CN: 编辑内容变化时触发，参数为编辑器当前文本。它是组件事件，`@change` 不会收到搜索栏输入框冒泡上来的原生 change。
change.en-US: Emitted when the content changes, with the editor's current text. It is a component event, so `@change` does not receive the native change bubbling up from the search bar inputs.

customRender.zh-CN: 替换被 options.customRenderRule 命中的 token 的内容，作用域参数为命中的规则 item、规则序号 index 与 token 原文 content；不提供或为空时保留原文。仅在只读模式下生效。
customRender.en-US: Replaces the content of a token matched by options.customRenderRule, with the matched rule item, its index and the token text content as scope parameters. Without it, or when empty, the token keeps its text. Only takes effect in read-only mode.

searchButton.zh-CN: 整体替换默认搜索按钮；defaultButton 是默认按钮的 VNode，用 `<component :is>` 渲染，其余参数用于自建搜索界面。showSearch 为 false 时不渲染。
searchButton.en-US: Replaces the default search button as a whole. defaultButton is the default button's VNode, rendered with `<component :is>`; the other parameters build a custom search UI. Not rendered when showSearch is false.

format.zh-CN: 按 formatOptions 格式化当前内容。

search.zh-CN: 搜索文本，可选参数控制大小写敏感、全词匹配和正则表达式。
search.en-US: Searches for text; the optional parameters control case sensitivity, whole word and regular expression.

prevSearch.zh-CN: 跳转到上一个搜索结果，可选步长。
prevSearch.en-US: Moves to the previous search result, with an optional step.

nextSearch.zh-CN: 跳转到下一个搜索结果，可选步长。
nextSearch.en-US: Moves to the next search result, with an optional step.

replace.zh-CN: 替换当前搜索匹配项；替换文本为空串时删除匹配，没有匹配时不做任何事。
replace.en-US: Replaces the current search match. An empty string deletes the match; without a match it does nothing.

replaceAll.zh-CN: 替换所有搜索匹配项；替换文本为空串时删除全部匹配。
replaceAll.en-US: Replaces all search matches. An empty string deletes them.

getStyle.zh-CN: 返回当前的 width 与 height。
getStyle.en-US: Returns the current width and height.
